observations: Mechanism and linkage views show separate anchor shoe, six rivets, shared mounting sets, spring/washer/nut stack, bell-crank pivot and rod clevis. Installed interfaces are independently checked in the saved native.

End and top views show the tangential eyebolt, tilted crank plane and separate carrier route; the return passes beyond the anchor plate edge. Source figures do not recover these profiles or the shared mount.
Installed isometric retains the clutch, pump and auxiliary-control context. Engine/crankshaft and engine frame remain absent; the floor is replacement development context.

Side view preserves engine-left/transmission-right orientation. The inherited upright fork and larger anchor/carrier arrangement are not a traced match to the more compact, differently angled SNL2 depiction. Exact stations, source registration and overall clutch envelope require renewed review with engine/frame geometry.

HB118 supports attachment of the band to a clutch-shaft bracket; HB150-151 describes the operating chain. Neither establishes the chosen left bracket, carrier profile, pivot orientation or unprinted dimensions.
Plate95 resembles the larger side-brake arrangement. Its profile is not transferred to this smaller stop-band model.
